overall_assessment: Nord's uniform page structure is read well: headings map correctly, learning outcomes keep all Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups, and admission/cost/evaluation boilerplate is dropped. The main weakness is the assessment/coursework_requirements split inside the Eksamensbeskrivelse block, which is done per paragraph and often misfiles or fragments obligatory-participation text. Smaller issues: dropped lead paragraph, '.' placeholder prerequisites and Praksis text appended to teaching_methods. The 4 'no sections' suspects are true stubs (only an overlap list) and are correct.

findings.evidence: Det kreves minimum 80 prosent obligatorisk deltakelse i undervisningen for å få avsluttende vurdering i emnet.
findings.description: Within Eksamensbeskrivelse, pass/fail gates (obligatorisk deltakelse, obligatorisk arbeid, arbeidskrav) stay in assessment although the codebook puts them in coursework_requirements. MUS2015: the OD paragraph is in assessment while coursework_requirements holds only the label 'Obligatorisk deltakelse (OD)'. REL1004: the excursion and 'Obligatorisk arbeid' mappe text sits in assessment and coursework_requirements ends with the orphan label 'Obligatorisk arbeid (OA):'. KRO5001: 'Inntil 4 arbeidskrav (AK)' is in assessment and there is no coursework row. MUS1002 likewise keeps the OD line in assessment while only AK is split out.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Eksamensbeskrivelse block is split into assessment/coursework per line or paragraph by keyword (OD/AK/arbeidskrav) in the coursework splitter; a label line followed by a separate paragraph, or a keyword-less continuation, stays in assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: In the coursework splitter for Nord, treat a label paragraph (e.g. 'Obligatorisk deltakelse (OD)', 'Obligatorisk arbeid (OA):') together with the following paragraph(s) up to the next labelled exam form (Mappe, Eksamen, Skriftlig, Oppgave) as one unit; also match 'obligatorisk deltakelse/deltaking', 'arbeidskrav', 'Obligatorisk oppmøte' in any paragraph of the block.

findings.evidence: Obligatorisk deltakelse (OD): Krav om tilstedeværelse på minst 80 % av undervisningen. Vurdering:
findings.description: A sentence broken by a blank line in the source ('Vurdering:' / 'Godkjent/ikke godkjent.') is cut across two sections: coursework_requirements ends at 'Vurdering:' and assessment begins with the stray 'Godkjent/ikke godkjent.'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Paragraph-wise routing of the exam block treats the blank-line-separated continuation as a separate paragraph without the OD keyword.
findings.suggested_fix: Attach a paragraph that follows a paragraph ending in ':' (or consisting only of 'Godkjent/ikke godkjent') to the preceding paragraph before routing.

findings.evidence: Masteroppgaven skal være et selvstendig vitenskapelig arbeid som studenten skal demonstrere innsikt i aktuell forskning
findings.description: The lead paragraph on the page between the course code and the first heading ('Beskrivelse av emnet') is dropped. For the master's courses it is the only statement of the course aim; for MAT5002 it opens the course description. course_content contains only the text under 'Beskrivelse av emnet'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Text before the first recognised heading is not assigned to any section (preamble ignored) by the block reader / sectionize().
findings.suggested_fix: For nord, put non-empty preamble text between the title/code lines and the first heading into course_content (prepend), after removing the title and course code lines.

findings.description: Forkunnskapskrav consisting only of '.' is emitted as a prerequisites row and the real recommendation from 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' is concatenated after it, giving text that begins with a stray '.'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: .clean_sections() does not strip punctuation-only lines before concatenating the two prerequisite headings.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() drop lines with no alphanumeric characters (e.g. '.', '-') and treat a section with only such lines as empty.

findings.evidence: Det kreves ingen forkunnskaper utover opptakskravet.
findings.description: Prerequisites row holds only the identical 'no prerequisites beyond admission' sentence (flagged boilerplate, true but harmless): the real Forkunnskapskrav text, the admission rule, is correctly dropped, so the row carries no information.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Anbefalte forkunnskaper boilerplate sentence repeated across a course family.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the sentence to the boilerplate/placeholder list so the prerequisites row is not emitted (or is marked as 'none').

findings.evidence: Se egen plan for praksis i kompetanseguiden.
findings.description: The Praksis heading is mapped to teaching_methods, so placement text and pure pointers ('Se egen plan for praksis ...', 'Obligatorisk tilstedeværelse.') are appended to the teaching methods. The pointers are noise; obligatory attendance in MAT2005 is a coursework requirement.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the mapping but drop pure reference lines ('Se egen plan/Kompetanseguiden ...') in .clean_sections(); acceptable otherwise.
